text:
maria: Heads-up — kicking off a small canary for mobile-api v2.3.1 in ~10m. Please skim the backout/runbook link and be ready to hit the quick-unwind steps if metrics degrade. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-backout (RB-42).

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by maria. rollout_id=r-2026-03-20-01. Routing policy: 5% traffic -> mobile-api:v2.3.1. Pin: commit abc1234. Change window: 03/20 01:00-02:00 UTC.

maria: Quick summary of triggers that should cause immediate backout: p95 latency >200ms for 3 consecutive minutes, error-rate >2% for 2 minutes, 5xx >1% for 2 minutes, any OOM/host-level issues. If triggered, follow the quick-backout steps below and open an incident.

maria: Quick-backout (copy/paste):
```
# restore previous image and unpin from gateway
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/mobile-api mobile-api=mobile-api:v2.3.0
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/mobile-api --timeout=2m
# if we pinned traffic at gateway layer
gatewayctl unpin --service mobile-api --version v2.3.1
# mark rollout aborted in CICD
cictl annotate-rollout r-2026-03-20-01 --status aborted --reason "automatic backout: metrics breach"
```

sam: ACK. I'll own the first 10m watch and escalate to oncall if I see sustained p95 spike. Will post metric snapshots if anything odd.

jay: Add a gate for DB error rates too — any SQL timeouts >0.5% should also trigger. Also ask infra to keep an eye on replica memory.

lucy: Reminder: DB migration is delayed-only and behind a feature flag. If we do need a rollback that touches migrations, follow RB-42 section "rollback-db": `scripts/rollback_db_migrations.sh --target=pre-v2.3.1` and coordinate with data team.

ops-bot: If a rollback is executed, please create an incident with label `release-rollout` and include rollout_id=r-2026-03-20-01. Pager rules: severity P2 if user-facing errors persist >10m.

maria: Please react with :thumbsup: if you can cover alerts for the next 30m (sam/jay/lucy on the thread).

sam: :thumbsup:

jay: :thumbsup:

lucy: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary started (timestamp=2178003468). routing: 5% -> v2.3.1.

systems-monitor: metric snapshot @ +3m: p95=180ms, error-rate=0.4%, 5xx=0.1% (no threshold breaches).

maria: Good. We will check again at +5m and +10m. If green at +15m, we will step to 25%.

sam: Noted — seeing a small p95 jitter around 190-195ms, still below 200ms threshold.

systems-monitor: ALERT (suppressed): transient spike of CPU on node gpu-04 at +7m — no OOM, container restarted historically 0 times.

maria: CPU spike noticed but no OOM. Continue watch. If it repeats or we see OOMs, execute quick-backout.

deploy-bot: Canary passed window_1 (10m). stepping to 25% (timestamp=2178003512).

lucy: Updating release notes: add migration flag instructions and link to RB-42. I'll push the notes after full rollout.

maria: Thanks — closing loop for canary: passed. Leaving this thread open until full rollout completes. If anyone sees late regressions, reply here with metrics + logs. /cc @oncall

ops-bot: Reminder: post-mortem checklist if rollback occurs — collect traces, config diffs, and CI artifacts.

maria: Team — great job. Will schedule a quick retro if we hit any issues. Otherwise proceeding with gradual ramp per rollout plan.
